newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland's Tele plans advert-call scheme.
newsitem.headline: Finland's Tele plans advert-call scheme.

text.p: State telecoms operator Telecom Finland said on Monday it would be one of the first to launch an option for cut-rate local and international calls if users agree to hear an advertisement before they speak.

Tele said in a statement it was launching the scheme, already fully operational in Sweden, among 200 users in Lappeenranta, south-east Finland. A spokesman said the company believed it was among the first to try out the idea.
Users who agree to hear an advertisement first will get 10 minutes free talk on a local call, or 10 minutes at a cut rate for an international call, Tele said.
